detailed_descriptions.en: The Space Engineers 2 Pioneer Edition DLC is an extension package to the Space Engineers 2 game. It is a special package for early explorers, featuring a breathtaking soundtrack, exclusive content, and the chance to directly support the game’s development. Dive into the world of Space Engineers 2 at its earliest stage, with thrilling updates on the way, and enjoy the official soundtrack, a creative vault filled with concept art sketches, behind-the-scenes materials from the developers, and stunning exclusive wallpapers. Vertical Slice 2 brings a substantial content upgrade to the Pioneer Edition, expanding the artbook with new tools, construction stages, components, suits, and character designs that further define visual direction of Space Engineers 2. A major highlight is the introduction of planetary content: with VS2 enabling in-game planetary exploration, the Pioneer Edition now includes newly added sections dedicated to worlds like Verdure and Kemik. These pages showcase updated biomes, foliage systems, planetary lighting, terrain details, and environmental diversity shaping SE2’s next-generation planets. We’ve also enriched the engineering experience with redesigned tools, decorative blocks, propulsion upgrades, and improved welding equipment. Altogether, these additions make the Pioneer Edition a richer, more complete window into the evolving universe of Space Engineers 2 — from characters and tools all the way to living, breathing planets. And there is more to come! As Space Engineers 2 evolves, we plan to bring even more exclusive content to the Pioneer Edition, including new music tracks, wallpapers and concept art, and other exciting materials along the way. Thanks for being part of this journey with us! Space Engineers 2 Pioneer Edition DLC includes: Official Soundtrack : Be among the first to enjoy epic tracks from Karel Antonin, inspired by a rich tapestry of ethnic styles, including Eastern European, Arabian, Indian, and Northern European influences. The score blends traditional instruments with modern synthesizers, all brought to life by a professional symphonic orchestra. Creative Vault : Discover the creative origins of Space Engineers 2 with a collection of early concept art and see how the game is coming together with exclusive behind-the-scenes materials, developer notes, and other exciting insights. Exclusive Wallpapers: Discover a set of exclusive wallpapers for PC and phone, featuring beautifully realistic spaceships and bring the game's ambiance to your screens. Note: The content for the Space Engineers 2 Pioneer Edition DLC can be found on your local drive in the following folder: Steam\steamapps\common\SpaceEngineers2\PioneerEdition

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Space Engineers 2 Pioneer Edition DLC is an extension package to the Space Engineers 2 game. 

It is a special package for early explorers, featuring a breathtaking soundtrack, exclusive content, and the chance to directly support the game’s development.

Dive into the world of Space Engineers 2 at its earliest stage, with thrilling updates on the way, and enjoy the official soundtrack, a creative vault filled with concept art sketches, behind-the-scenes materials from the developers, and stunning exclusive wallpapers.

Vertical Slice 2 brings a substantial content upgrade to the Pioneer Edition, expanding the artbook with new tools, construction stages, components, suits, and character designs that further define visual direction of Space Engineers 2.

A major highlight is the introduction of planetary content: with VS2 enabling in-game planetary exploration, the Pioneer Edition now includes newly added sections dedicated to worlds like Verdure and Kemik. These pages showcase updated biomes, foliage systems, planetary lighting, terrain details, and environmental diversity shaping SE2’s next-generation planets.

We’ve also enriched the engineering experience with redesigned tools, decorative blocks, propulsion upgrades, and improved welding equipment. Altogether, these additions make the Pioneer Edition a richer, more complete window into the evolving universe of Space Engineers 2 — from characters and tools all the way to living, breathing planets.

And there is more to come! As Space Engineers 2 evolves, we plan to bring even more exclusive content to the Pioneer Edition, including new music tracks, wallpapers and concept art, and other exciting materials along the way.

Thanks for being part of this journey with us!

Space Engineers 2 Pioneer Edition DLC includes:

  • Official Soundtrack: Be among the first to enjoy epic tracks from Karel Antonin, inspired by a rich tapestry of ethnic styles, including Eastern European, Arabian, Indian, and Northern European influences. The score blends traditional instruments with modern synthesizers, all brought to life by a professional symphonic orchestra.

  • Creative Vault: Discover the creative origins of Space Engineers 2 with a collection of early concept art and see how the game is coming together with exclusive behind-the-scenes materials, developer notes, and other exciting insights.

  • Exclusive Wallpapers: Discover a set of exclusive wallpapers for PC and phone, featuring beautifully realistic spaceships and bring the game's ambiance to your screens.

Note: The content for the Space Engineers 2 Pioneer Edition DLC can be found on your local drive in the following folder: Steam\steamapps\common\SpaceEngineers2\PioneerEdition
